proposals.name: Quiet Walls
proposals.why: A good gallery is remembered for its quiet walls, and this panel should step back the same way so that the painting is the first thing the eye finds.

proposals.name: Courtyard Lanterns
proposals.why: Elene Akhvlediani's Tbilisi courtyards each keep one small lantern lit so the street stays quiet, and this panel should keep its own light low enough that the painting, not the panel, is what the eye meets.

proposals.name: The Picture Light
proposals.why: A gallery's picture light falls on one painting and nothing else, and this name does the same job for the panel, lighting the picture and leaving the chrome in the dark.
